description:
Fix the correctness defects that a repository-wide simplification and performance audit surfaced, so v1.0 ships without them.

## Background

A read-only audit of the workspace on 2026-10-15 (20 area auditors and a synthesis pass) collected simplification, abstraction and performance findings. Along the way it surfaced correctness defects, and each was then re-verified against current code and, where possible, reproduced in a scratch repository. They span:

- **Mutation integrity:** multi-step updates that commit partially, and bulk terminal updates that skip the dependent-readiness cascade.
- **Coordination:** lease reads that re-evict the same expired lease on every call, an ignored stale threshold, a misreported enforcement mode, a claim filter that is accepted but ignored, and a pre-commit hook guarding paths from an obsolete storage layout.
- **Input handling:** a query lexer that panics on non-ASCII text, a malformed ripgrep command line, inconsistent issue-id resolution, and search label filters that reject wildcards.
- **Surfaces:** a server that fails every storage read under its default relative data directory, a graph export that drops in-scope issues, orphan validation that reads the type-to-namespace mapping backwards, and a test that races the process environment.

Each child issue is standalone, with its own reproduction and criteria. The refactoring themes from the same audit are out of scope here.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every defect filed under this epic is fixed, and each fix is covered by a regression test that fails on the pre-fix code.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every documented reproduction in the child issues produces the corrected behaviour on the release build.
- [hard] REQ-03: No fix introduces a parallel variant of an existing mechanism; where a defect stems from duplicated logic, the fix converges it on one source (`@/inv/convention-convergence`).

## Notes

The audit's ranked report of simplification, abstraction and performance opportunities is a separate input for later epics.
title: Fix correctness defects found by the v1.0 code audit
